conditions.description: Quote responses update total without request-version, cancellation, or quantity matching.
conditions.rationale: A slower response for an older quantity can overwrite the total for a newer quantity.

conditions.description: The Place order control is a div with onClick and has no native button semantics or keyboard handler.
conditions.rationale: Keyboard-only users do not receive the native activation behavior of a button.

conditions.description: The quantity input has no associated label, aria-label, or aria-labelledby attribute.
conditions.rationale: Its accessible name is not established by this component.

conditions.description: submit has no in-flight guard and the Place order control remains activatable during the request.
conditions.rationale: Repeated activation can call placeOrder multiple times before the first request resolves.

conditions.description: Status text is exposed through role=status with aria-live=polite.
conditions.rationale: A live-region status control is explicitly present and must not be reported as absent.

conditions.description: The quantity increment action uses a native button with type=button.
conditions.rationale: This control has native button semantics and should not be conflated with the div-based Place order control.

conditions.description: Whether placeOrder is idempotent or deduplicates repeated requests is not established by this client component.
conditions.rationale: Server-side order semantics require external API evidence.

conditions.description: Observed behavior across browsers and assistive technologies is not established by static component source.
conditions.rationale: Runtime accessibility behavior requires executed browser/AT evidence.

conditions.description: The checkout must not be cleared as keyboard-accessible and correctly labeled.
conditions.rationale: The primary order action lacks button keyboard semantics and the quantity input lacks an accessible name.

conditions.description: The checkout must not be cleared as protected against stale totals and duplicate order submission.
conditions.rationale: Quote responses can race and submit lacks an in-flight guard while server idempotency remains unknown.
